note: Episode data taken from this guide's own tables. Episode 149 is listed as both anime canon and filler in the article; it is shown as filler here until Devin confirms.
verdict: Only 18 of 170 episodes are filler. Skip 15, keep 3 fan favourites, and never skip the anime-canon timeskip (130–157).
